statement: Place K=4 counterfactual forks on repository-agent trajectories at tool-call boundaries where the policy is not near-deterministic and the KL between its reference-conditioned and plain next-action distribution (minus a placebo) is largest; siblings sampled from the policy, 1/(K+1) continuation weighting; validate placement against executed-replay ground truth and compare against flat groups and free branching at matched compute.
claim: The reference-conditioned-vs-plain divergence is a pilot-free estimate of the between-actions variance Var_pi[Q] (chi-square = Var/V^2 exactly), so forks placed by it beat entropy placement and beat flat groups at matched compute on repository tasks.
why_now: Forks on SWE tasks became affordable (BPO July; CRR NeurIPS 2026); the executed-replay ruler exists (Zhang, Aug); the branching objective exists (EPIG, Sept 17); the Bayes identity is stated (PBSD, GraphHCA).

killing_experiment.design: ~50 tool-call boundaries on SWE-smith; nested forks (4 actions x 2 continuations) to measure Var_a[Q] by one-way ANOVA; correlate with reference-KL, entropy, belief-shift on measurable boundaries against a within-trajectory shuffled control.
killing_experiment.kills_if: reference-KL does not beat entropy by >= 0.05 AUROC / rank correlation on measurable boundaries, or the placebo KL is within 50% of the real KL.

neighbors.title: ProVer
neighbors.trick: A judge contrasts successful and failed rollouts to propose a pivotal segment; forks before and after it verify the segment's advantage before it enters GRPO.
neighbors.difference: Judge-nominated and fork-verified; ours is reference-nominated and state-level; theirs is on ALFWorld/WebShop/SearchQA.

neighbors.title: GraphHCA
neighbors.trick: Bayes turns the hindsight ratio into a ratio of success probabilities at consecutive states; estimate the state potential from pooled rollouts on the transition graph.
neighbors.difference: Occupies the telescoping identity and a model-free estimator on recurring-state tasks; not placement, not repositories.

neighbors.title: EPIG-Tree
neighbors.trick: Branch where the between-actions variance per cost is largest, estimated from pilots.
neighbors.difference: We replace the pilots with the reference-conditioned divergence.

neighbors.title: Belief-Shift Branching
neighbors.trick: Fork before the step where the model's own answer belief jumps most.
neighbors.difference: Model's belief vs the task reference; math vs environment.

neighbors.difference: No learned nominator, no expert, no preference loss.
